title: Book One · Chapter 106: The Long Way Home Together
story:
Mei cannot walk with the boys after school.

She is meeting her cousin by the front gate. Mei saved money to buy a drawing brush. She is going with her cousin to choose it. She tells Ronan about her plan. On project days, they often walk together after school.

“Can we come?” Leo asks.

“Not today. We have another visit after.”

She waves and goes. Leo watches her meet a girl with a red bag.

“She has plans,” he says.

“So have we.”

“What plans?”

Ronan looks at him. “Walking.”

Leo laughs. They tell Miss Wu about their walk home. Their parents know the longer way past Mr Qiu's stall. The boys choose that way today. They stay on the path, away from the river steps.

At the stall, Mr Qiu is wrapping exercise books in brown paper. The street map is still under a clear cover beside him. One corner is faded now.

Leo points at Mei's tea-shop sign. “You need a new cup,” he says.

“The real cup or the paper cup?” Mr Qiu asks.

“The paper one.”

“Then ask the artist when she has time.”

Ronan looks at the route on their old map. It still leads to East Court. The old rice shop is still shut. A new low bench stands outside the tea shop. The three white stones are still on the wall.

Mr Qiu asks about the school boat book. “The book is finished,” Ronan says. “Our string boat carried two stones,” Leo says. He wanted three, but he says two.

“Are you bringing your boats here?” Mr Qiu asks.

“No room for your pencils then,” Leo says.

“Quite right. I am not opening a harbour.”

Three loose sheets lift in the wind. The boys help Mr Qiu gather them. Then a customer comes and the boys move away from the narrow counter.

Along the next street, “Were you angry when I changed groups?” Leo asks.

“Yes.”

“I thought you were.”

“You laughed more at that table.”

“We had more boys at our table. We made more mistakes.”

Ronan smiles, then thinks. “I thought you did not want me.”

“I wanted the long boat.”

“That sounds simple when you say it now.”

“It was simple to me then.”

They stop for a cart to pass. Leo picks at the edge of his bag. Ronan watches a wheel go round. They are quiet for a while. Both boys stay quiet about future groups.

“Will you play at the field on Saturday?” Ronan asks.

“Morning, perhaps. My father is taking me somewhere after lunch.”

“Then I will ask about morning.”

At the corner, they part. Ronan walked further today. He gets home later than usual. But he is back on time. Mum agreed to this home time with him. She checks the clock. “Did you buy the thread?” she asks.

He takes the thread from his dry pocket. It stayed away from his pencil tin. He gives it to Mum. Then he opens his bag.

That evening, he puts the school folder under the rough street map. Mei and Leo helped with the map. At school, they worked in different groups. Ronan puts both sets of pages safely away. He enjoyed the projects and his walk with Leo today.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- path＝小路
- faded＝褪色了
- harbour＝港口
- on time＝按时

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：cousin＝堂／表姐妹；exercise book＝练习本；route＝路线。

## 读句提示

**Did you buy the thread?**

你／买了／那根线吗？直接向Ronan核对买线任务。

## 理解问题

1. Leo怎样解释自己当时换组的想法？
2. 本章哪些细节表明朋友各自也有生活安排？
